name: High Roller / two-live-one-adjacent-opponent-same-target-twice
notes: Repair-only. Declare two separate Intimidate targets before asset costs even before a roll; evaluate printed Red4+ condition only on resolution. Same Hero across separate instances is an inference from CR1.8.5b and Everfest two-instance note, informed by supplied rules-chat interpretation, not a published card ruling. Never select a new target at resolution. One adjacent opponent control uses the existing two-live fixture setup explicitly; it is NOT credited as four-live. A real Bone Head Barrier Instant rolls after High Roller was declared; original hands must remain intact until High Roller itself resolves. Then exactly two distinct physical cards are banished facedown to their owners.  UPF TRP9.3: adjacent heroes only; separate one-target effects do not receive multi-target adjacency exception. Start with one resource to pay the printed one-resource Bone Head Barrier cost; no die/bonus outcomes preseeded. Opponent legally destroys equipped Gamblers Gloves to reroll the actual Barrier die. Only final accepted result counts.
